title: Vertiv AI Roadshow in Santa Clara, CA highlights AI infrastructure imperatives for future-ready AI factories
summary: Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, today announced the next stop of its global AI Solutions Roadshow in Santa Clara, California. The event will showcase how data centers can adapt to the growing demands of artificial intelligence (AI) through a broad set of infrastructure imperatives across data center design, cooling, power, services, rack systems, and management. The event targets end customers, partners and other stakeholders, including hyperscalers, cloud and neocloud providers, enterprise organizations, consulting engineering firms, contractors, and channel partners, and takes place on October 8, 2025, in Santa Clara, California.
